q: How do I estimate the CBAM cost per tonne of Turkish rebar in 2026?
title: Turkish rebar: CBAM cost in 2026
short: Take the embedded emissions per tonne, subtract the free allocation adjustment for the year, multiply by the certificate price and subtract any Turkish carbon price paid. In 2026 the adjustment still covers 97.5 percent of the benchmark, so a scrap based arc furnace mill with verified data pays far less than default values imply.
audience: Turkish rebar exporters and EU importers budgeting for CBAM certificates

ul: Embedded emissions per tonne: verified actual data or the default value with its mark-up.
The benchmark used for the free allocation adjustment, and the phase out share for the year.
The certificate price, set from EU ETS auction prices.
Any carbon price effectively paid in Turkey.

p: The free allocation share falls each year until 2034, so the same tonne costs more every year. Run the numbers year by year, not once.
